evidence:
Pairwise review of all 53 scored criteria (43 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual) plus 2 zero-weight gates. Most of the rubric is carefully partitioned with explicit ownership carve-outs: hro_arrive_bottom defers multi-card arrival to hro_bulk_move; hro_interview_full defers bulk overfill to hro_bulk_places and undo overfill to hro_undo_full; hro_activity vs hro_activity_refusals is split by prompt.md:19; hro_candidate_view defers the candidate reply to hro_msg_exchange; hro_candidate_linked 'alone owns that link'; hro_pol_live_thread 'owns the draft and focus' and defers scrolled-up placement to Functional. Role refusals are disjoint by action set: hro_observer_readonly (move/add/open-job/note), hro_thread_access (observer send), hro_candidate_no_staff (writes) vs hro_candidate_private (reads), hro_anonymous (401 set), hro_mgr_other_job (move) vs hro_notes (other-manager note). No pair demands incompatible products (checked e.g. hro_msg_compose empty-after-send vs hro_pol_failed_send keep-on-failure; hro_pol_session_resume per-user drafts vs hro_drafts per-conversation drafts; hro_anonymous 401 vs rules 1). Shared preconditions (live transport needed by hro_live_board and hro_pol_live_board; pagination by hro_thread_earlier and hro_pol_earlier_place) are positive-control dependencies required by REVIEW_POLICY, not duplicate grading (check 40 territory).
DEFECT 1 (overlap, P2): the same observable -- another person's application appearing on a candidate's page -- is a fail condition in two weighted rows. functional/judge.toml:380 hro_candidate_view (w1.5): 'each candidate sees only their own applications ... Fails if title, team, wording, ownership or the conversation is wrong.' functional/judge.toml:389 hro_candidate_private (w2.5): 'no response a candidate page receives contains ... other candidates ... Fails if any of that data or existence leaks.' Anything rendered on the candidate page came from a response, so the visible-ownership leg of hro_candidate_view is subsumed by hro_candidate_private. Meanwhile functional/prompt.md:23 says 'Never deduct one observed defect in more than one row' without naming the owner, so attribution is left to the judge.
DEFECT 2 (minor overlap, P3): functional/judge.toml:308 hro_msg_compose (w1) 'afterwards the box is empty' and functional/judge.toml:371 hro_drafts (w2) 'Fails if a draft ... survives sending' both fail an app that leaves the sent text in the box; no ownership note.
DEFECT 3 (minor overlap, P3): visual/judge.toml:25-26 hro_vis_type anchors grade 'deliberate alignment' / 'alignment issues' and visual/judge.toml:54 hro_vis_layout grades 'spacing and alignment of the board columns and cards'; mitigated by visual/prompt.md:14 'Do not deduct the same observed defect in more than one row' but owner unnamed.
Not a defect: gate hro_gate_shared repeating the job-open/add-candidate visibility of hro_job_open/hro_add_candidate (gates carry 0 weight). Out of scope here but noticed for check 26/33 owners: hro_activity says 'every successful action you performed on J1 and J2' while prompt.md:49 lists only S, M, L, C, B and R (K's reject/reopen on Tomas's J2 card and V's Mei moves are on J1/J2).
counterexample: Broken app: the candidate applications list is not filtered by owner, so Noor sees Tomas's and Lena's applications. Under prompt.md:23 the judge must deduct this once, and hro_candidate_view names 'ownership' explicitly, so a judge can zero hro_candidate_view (w1.5) and pass hro_candidate_private (w2.5): the privacy leak keeps the heavier privacy row. A different judge run zeroes both (4.0 weight), contrary to prompt.md:23, so the same app scores differently depending on attribution. Similar ambiguity for an app that never clears the message box after send (hro_msg_compose vs hro_drafts).
suggested_fix: Give one owner per observable: e.g. reword hro_candidate_view to 'each candidate's own applications all appear with title, team and candidate wording ...; whether other people's applications appear is graded only in hro_candidate_private', drop 'survives sending' from hro_drafts (or state 'clearing the box after send is graded in hro_msg_compose'), and remove 'alignment' from the hro_vis_type anchors (layout owns it).
